question: Can the existing tracked-source fingerprint repair be promoted without allowing physical release-source bytes or generated live-glob residue to diverge from the claimed Git candidate?
established_falsifications: git status/diff cleanliness alone is insufficient because assume-unchanged and skip-worktree can hide working-tree mutations
content blob identity alone is insufficient for full physical custody because executable-mode drift can leave blob bytes unchanged
the existing native/**/target/** source-segment residue exception is broader than the currently justified Cargo build-script class
proposed_invariant: prove index release-surface state equals HEAD
enumerate stage-0 mode/object identity for each fingerprinted tracked path
compare physical file mode and Git blob object identity to that committed state
feed the same physical bytes into the candidate SHA-256
fail closed on unexpected live release-glob paths; retain any build-residue exception only after lifecycle evidence observes the actual class

decisive_court.implementation: run on the pre-repair live-glob checker
decisive_court.decision: the first added/removed/content-changed fingerprint path owns the repair; if no lifecycle drift appears, retire setup/benchmark mutation as the explanation for that run

issue_130_topology_note: Candidate-identity custody should be manifest-derived and accumulated base-to-head; expensive product jobs may remain newest-commit scoped. A fingerprint delta with stale receipts must surface strict release-lock red even when product benchmarks are skipped.
